result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a bus shelter, but the environment is dominated by aged pavement and embedded streetcar tracks. Faded crosswalk markings and a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals reduce the overall safety and comfort for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Embedded Rail Tracks
hazards.description: Streetcar tracks embedded in the asphalt create uneven surfaces and potential slip hazards, especially in wet conditions.
hazards.location_in_image: Running through the center of the intersection and along the main roadway

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, which reduces their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with essential pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, signals, and curb ramps. The presence of embedded trolley tracks and shared lane markings for bicycles introduces additional navigational challenges and potential trip hazards within the roadway.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Steel tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and create uneven surfaces that are trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the marked crosswalk and along the main roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt near the tracks and crosswalk can lead to tripping.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection approach and within the crosswalk area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Constructing bulb-outs at the corners would reduce the crossing distance and increase the visibility of pedestrians to turning motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a 3-7 second head start, allowing them to establish themselves in the crosswalk before vehicles turn.

interventions.title: Pavement Maintenance
interventions.description: Repairing the asphalt around the trolley tracks and within the crosswalk area to ensure a smooth, level surface for pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and curb ramps. However, the crossing distance is relatively wide without a median refuge, and the presence of streetcar tracks in the roadway creates a potential tripping hazard.

hazards.name: Streetcar tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and right side of the intersection crossing

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a central refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk across the primary road

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a complex environment with embedded streetcar tracks and multiple overhead utility lines. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like marked crosswalks and signals are present, the wide crossing distance and degraded pavement around the tracks increase risk.

hazards.name: Embedded Rail Tracks
hazards.description: Streetcar tracks embedded in the roadway create uneven surfaces and gaps that are significant trip hazards for pedestrians and slip hazards for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The large intersection geometry increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic while crossing.

hazards.description: Faded crosswalk and lane markings reduce the visibility of pedestrian zones to approaching drivers.
